event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Broad risk-on, oil collapsed, gold ripped.
Nov 4 ADP printed 8.6 vs 6.9 fc and ISM Services held 54.5, driving a 75%-advance tape where gold/silver and financials led while chips and oil were sold; positioning is not crowded (VIX 16.6) but the 100% hike odds into Dec 9 keep the rate-sensitive rally fragile.

INDICES — VIX 16.6, below its 17.6 20-day MA.
DIA +3.10%, SPY +1.65%, IWM +1.51%, QQQ +0.97%, SOXX -3.14%. Large > small by 0.14pp. Biggest cross-asset move: USO -8.07% (WTI), with GLD +3.68% and SLV +5.17% as the mirror trade.

VOLUME & BREADTH — DIA ran 2.0x and RSP 1.8x average (accumulation), SOXX 1.6x on a down day (distribution in chips); SPY and QQQ vol_ratio not disclosed in the feed. XLY 2.4x and XLV 1.7x led sector volume; XLK 1.3x lagged. Breadth confirms: 72% above 50DMA, 65% above 200DMA, A/D 375/127, up/down volume 1.72, 149 new 60d highs vs 37 lows, narrow rally flag False.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLY Discretionary +4.26%, XLF Financials +3.51%, XLP Staples +3.36%, XLRE Real Estate +3.32%, XLV Healthcare +3.06%, XLU Utilities +0.44%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLB Materials +0.00%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLK Technology -0.01%, XLI Industrials -1.09%.
Top industries GDX +9.01% and SILJ +8.97%; bottom XOP -6.39% and USO -8.07%.
Five-day flows: XLF +$916mm (92p) and XLV +$723mm (94p) in; XLP -$366mm (15p) and XLY -$154mm (29p) out — financials/healthcare inflows confirm their leadership, staples outflow contradicts its +3.36% day (short-covering, not conviction).
Money is rotating into precious metals and financials, out of energy and chips; state: broad risk-on.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.53 and QQQ 1.36 = heavy protection demand despite the rally; SPY skew +6.9% and QQQ +8.1% put premium intact. SPY sits above GEX flip 770 with max pain 760; VIX 16.6 is under its 17.6 20-day MA (complacency creeping). VIXEQ 41.2 against VIX 16.6 is a wide gap — high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape, not a correlated macro tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Crude -8.07% on EIA builds and Iran peace headlines dragged XOP -6.39% while JETS +6.70% and IHI +6.72% rallied on the fuel-cost relief. Gold +3.68%/silver +5.17% with a -0.38% dollar is a debasement bid, not a fear bid. Next FOMC Dec 9: Polymarket 78% for a 25bp hike (+7pp in 5 days) vs 22% no change — CME FedWatch shows 100% hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 55.8, Neutral.
VST -13.83% on 3.2x volume after closing the Cogentrix acquisition; VRT -12.89% (no catalyst in feed) after a +5.43% Nov 3; WPM +11.99% into Q3 results Nov 5; GOLD +5.90% on 5.3x. Vol spikes TAN +5.65% at 5.5x and SRE -2.88% at 3.7x — TAN accumulation, SRE distribution. Best 20d sector XLRE +11.22%, worst XLK -12.36%; momentum regime MTUM +0.05 vs IWF -0.48.
Watch: SOXX -3.14% with 20d -22.72% despite a 100th-percentile $2.27bn inflow — a trend/capitulation divergence; GLD +3.68% at GEX flip 360 into a dollar breakdown; ORCL -1.95% on 3.0x volume, momentum break in software while IGV bleeds.
